_description: New York $20k pension/IRA exclusion (age 59.5+) zeroes state tax on a Traditional withdrawal at or below $20k. Verifies retirement-income exclusion behavior.
_rationale: Single filer, age 65, NY. $500k Traditional, no other income, $20k/yr living expenses (after-tax target). Withdrawal w solves: w − federal_tax(w) − state_tax(w) = 20000. NY excludes the first $20k Traditional withdrawal at age 65 (≥ 59.5). With $20k state-base and $8k NY std ded, state taxable = max(0, 0 - 8000) = 0 → state tax = $0. Federal tax on $20k - $16,100 std ded - $2,050 senior add-on - $6,000 OBBB senior bonus = $0 taxable income → federal tax also $0. So w = $20,000.
name: NY Pension Exclusion
